title: Extract a duplicated rule
prompt: The same discount rule is written three times in orders.js. Extract it into one function and use it everywhere. The behaviour must not change: the tests must still pass.
check: node --test && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('orders.js','utf8'); const n=(s.match(/0\\.9/g)||[]).length; if(n>1){console.error('the rule is still written '+n+' times');process.exit(1)}"
